proposed_facts.reason: The header declares all four enumerators. The implementation handles three policies explicitly; TERMINATE reaches default without queue mutation and still restores interrupts.
Reset removes scheduled lists, clears four direct requests, discards the queue, requests recalibration and clears the latch. Its rumble callees do not issue motor commands.

Immediate destinations and the fixed mask match the implementation. PADRecalibrate merges pending work, filters waiting/checking channels and conditionally marks recalibration. Callback device/spec branches and transfer failures prevent an unconditional fresh-origin guarantee.

The reset sequence saves, disables and restores interrupts. Motor emission occurs in the interpreter on status changes; PADRecalibrate starts DoReset only when ResettingChan equals its idle value of 32.
The four-port software reset mapping accurately distinguishes cleared requests and queued input from conditional downstream hardware effects.
